open_points.subject: AuditEntry creation for accepted no-op actions
open_points.text: “Registry records only significant changes of state” conflicts with “The actions that write an entry ... archiving, anonymising and deleting a project; ... erasing a customer” when State 0 says archiving an archived project, anonymising an anonymised project, and erasing an erased customer return unchanged.
open_points.question: Does an accepted action that returns an unchanged record create an AuditEntry and confirmation id, or are entries created only when state actually changes?
options: Create no entry because no state changed
Create an accepted entry for every invocation of a listed action
Define the result separately for each idempotent action
open_points.default_guess: Create no entry or confirmation id when the action leaves state unchanged.

open_points.subject: AuditEntry left by erasing old entries
open_points.text: “every entry older than the date the owner gives is gone; the erasure leaves an entry of its own naming the date”
open_points.question: If the owner gives a future cutoff date, so the new erasure entry is itself older than that date, does that new entry survive, is it erased too, or is such a cutoff refused?
options: Erase the pre-existing qualifying entries, then append an erasure entry that survives regardless of the cutoff
Erase the new erasure entry too because it qualifies
Refuse a cutoff date later than the action date
open_points.default_guess: Apply the cutoff to entries existing before the action, then append and retain the erasure entry.
